desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community is focused on a Russian ballistic missile strike on a Kryvyi Rih residential high-rise and President Trump’s public remarks that “very good chances” exist of ending the Ukraine war via “successful negotiations.” These two threads dominate recent posts from the listed accounts.

## MAIN THREADS
### Russian strike on Kryvyi Rih
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2123861094750142854) posted video of the impact and reported a ballistic missile hit a high-rise; follow-up noted 20 injured so far.
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2123864109691052541) added further footage and injury update, with multiple accounts amplifying the same clips.

### Trump on Ukraine peace prospects
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2123868715230081158) quoted Trump stating “there are very good chances of ending the war in Ukraine” and citing ongoing US negotiations.

### Ukrainian FPV drone strike on Russian artillery
- [@GeoConfirmed](https://x.com/GeoConfirmed/status/2123860159986311367) geolocated and confirmed destruction of a Russian BM-27 Uragan by FPV drones near Stepanivka, Zaporizhia Oblast, crediting @99Dominik_ footage and unit details.

### White House-related announcements
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2123864063067513266) reported Trump and Dana White each donating $100k to the Marine Corps Band, citing a White House official via Fox News.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2123870652612608420) reported Putin claiming Moscow is the “Third Rome” with no fourth, positioning Russian civilization as a “salvation ark” for Christian believers (unconfirmed).  
- [@JenniferJJacobs](https://x.com/JenniferJJacobs/status/2123871377203556659) shared video of White House ballroom construction progress (unconfirmed in defence context).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching for follow-on reporting on the Kryvyi Rih casualties and any official Ukrainian or Russian statements on the strike. Trump’s negotiation remarks are expected to generate further commentary on possible US-Russia talks.
